title: Transformers
description: Follow token representations from embeddings and core mechanisms to extensions, efficient execution, and interpretability.

children.title: Core mechanisms
children.description: Token states, attention, normalization, and the interface between training and generation.

children.title: Structural extensions
children.description: Expert routing, residual connectivity, recurrent depth, and state-space hybrids.

children.title: Efficient execution
children.description: Caches, attention kernels, sparsity, compression, and decoding throughput.

children.title: Observability & interpretability
children.description: Inspect internal states with lenses, probes, Jacobians, causal interventions and feature circuits.

title: Learning & adaptation
description: Explore how credit is assigned, networks evolve, and useful changes persist.

children.title: Credit assignment
children.description: Compare gradient-based updates and local learning dynamics.

children.title: Gradients & local objectives
children.description: Backpropagation, biological constraints, feedback alignment, and local losses.

children.title: Predictive coding
children.description: Infer activities through local prediction errors, then examine the multiplier-based PC-ALM extension.

children.title: Neural dynamics
children.description: Spiking events and continuous-time state evolution are distinct from the choice of learning rule.

children.title: Neuroevolution
children.description: Evolve weights and topology directly, or generate connectivity from geometry.

children.title: Memory & continual learning
children.description: Context, external memory, weight updates, retention, and verified self-improvement.

title: Multimodal & world models
description: Connect modality interfaces and objectives to predictive representations and latent world models.

children.title: Modality interfaces & objectives
children.description: Fusion, alignment, generation, and grounding across image, audio, and video.

children.title: Predictive representations
children.description: JEPA predicts representations; action-conditioned world models connect prediction to planning.

title: Generation & latent computation
description: Explore generative constructions and computation in continuous representation spaces.

children.title: Generative constructions
children.description: Diffusion and flow matching define different ways to construct and sample a distribution.

children.title: Continuous computation
children.description: Distinguish learned input vectors, soft-token mixtures, and latent reasoning.

title: Embodied intelligence
description: Connect perception, beliefs, action distributions, and closed-loop evaluation.

children.title: Policies & action representations
children.description: Vision–language–action interfaces and discrete, diffusion, or flow-based action heads.

children.title: Inference & control
children.description: Belief updates, preferences, and policy selection in Active Inference.

children.title: Closed-loop evaluation
children.description: Measure the deployed perception–action loop and identify its failure modes.

title: Intellectual lineage
description: Trace the ideas that shaped modern neural architectures without imposing one reading order.

children.title: Representations & sequence models
children.description: Distributed representations, recurrence, and the emergence of attention.

children.title: Residual learning & scaling
children.description: Residual connections and the path from Transformers to language-model scaling.
